message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Notes |
|-------|----------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also known as *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | The first book in the Harry Potter series; introduces the wizarding world. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Continues Harry’s adventures at Hogwarts. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Introduces Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Features the Triwizard Tournament. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Focuses on the formation of Dumbledore’s Army. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Provides deeper insight into Voldemort’s past. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Concludes the epic saga. |
| **Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them** | 2001 (book) / 2016 (film) | A companion book to the film series; expands the wizarding world. |
| **Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald** (book) | 2018 | Companion to the second film. |
| **Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore** (book) | 2022 | Companion to the third film. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel, set in a small English town. |
| **The Ickabog** | 2020 | A children’s fable published as a free e‑book during the COVID‑19 pandemic. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | First book in the Cormoran Strike detective series. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **The Midnight Library** | 2020 | A speculative fiction novel about choices and alternate lives. |

These titles cover Rowling’s most widely read and celebrated works, from the beloved Harry Potter series to her ventures into adult fiction and the Cormoran Strike detective novels.
